 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Aditya Singh Rathore For Respondent(s) : Mr. M.S. Bhati, PP

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Ms. Neha Goenka, prosecutrix
present-in-person  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 22/03/2023
The present second bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.444/2021 Police Station Ratangarh, District Churu for the offences punishable under Sections 498-A, 323, 354, 354(A), 376(2) and 377 of the IPC.
The first bail application was dismissed as not pressed by this Court vide order dated 15.11.2022.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that similar situated co-accused Ramkrishan @ Hiren has already been granted bail by this Court and the case of the present petitioner is not distinguishable from that of the co-accused.
The petitioner is in judicial custody since 08.11.2021 and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time.
Therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
The complainant is present-in-person, she mentioned that she does not want to continue the present case.
I have considered the arguments advanced before me and gone through the material available on record.

Rahul vs State Of Rajasthan on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40491820/
1
Taking into account the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to release the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner, Rahul S/o Rameshchandra, shall be enlarged on bail in FIR No.444/2021 Police Station Ratangarh, District Churu provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 68-Rashi/-
